_about: Provenance + packing config for scripts/build-pixellab-extras.py. Download zips from https://api.pixellab.ai/mcp/characters/<id>/download to /tmp/pixellab-extras/<key>.zip (kish, kishdale, catcat, mittens, ella), then run python3 scripts/build-pixellab-extras.py.

kishdale._about: Kish (same NPC) in a different outfit; files mirror Kish's layout exactly. Kish_stand.png order (verified pixel-for-pixel against Kish's PixelLab rotations): S, SE, E, NE, N, NW, W, SW.
kishdale.description: cute Filipina teenage girl in casual wear long grey tights and yellow tee shirt long black wavy hair, wearing a canvas tote bag (Kish's alternate outfit)

outputs.Kishdale_stand.png: 544x68, 8 rotations S, SE, E, NE, N, NW, W, SW

kishdale.known_issues: Kishdale's base art has long loose hair (Kish has a ponytail); the canvas tote bag is mostly hidden in the south walk; north walk legs alternate dark grey / blue-grey. Walk template could not be read back from Kish's 'Walking' group, so walking-8-frames was used; crouch uses the 'crouching' template like Kish (5 frames, last frames lift off the ground in both).

catcat.name: cat cat
catcat.description: Cute domestic grey tabby cat with white chest and paws (PixelLab quadruped 'cat' template, 8 directions, 92x92). The base state is drawn SITTING and its north rotation is a front view, so walking/standing come from a 'Standing' state.

Standing.edit_description: standing up on all four legs in a relaxed neutral stance, ready to walk, tail raised. The north view shows the cat from behind: its back, tail and the backs of its ears, no face.

catcat._feet_row_why: Standing south rotation feet are row 72, but the skeleton-v3 south walk holds the tail ~10 px higher; feet on row 76 keeps every strip inside the 92 px cell

cells.note: real (skeleton-v3 walk-8-frames; the template walk south drew the cat at half size)
MIRRORED run east (the generated run west reads as a stretched pounce, inconsistent with east)
real: last frame of template 'sitting' north (from behind; base north rotation is a front view)
real: template 'idle' south (sitting idle loop), every other frame
real: v3 custom 'lies down and curls up ... to sleep' from the sitting pose; ends lying with eyes closed (not a tight curl)

catcat.unused_animations: base 'walk' (S/E/N/W, drawn from the sitting base: south is a shrunken sitting bob, north faces the camera), base 'sitting'/'seated-on-belly-idle' south (no visible change), Standing 'run' west, Standing 'walk' south (half-size cat)
catcat.known_issues: The template 'idle' (sitting loop, row 6 cols 4-7) draws the cat ~10% smaller than the base sitting rotations in row 6 cols 0-3, so switching sit S -> idle loop pops in size. Sit N is the last frame of a template 'sitting' on the Standing state and reads much like a standing cat from behind. Sleep is a sit -> lie-down with eyes closed, not a tight curl. Template walks (rows 1-3) draw the cat slightly smaller than the Standing rotations (row 8).

mittens.name: mittens
mittens.description: Cute black and white tuxedo cat (PixelLab quadruped 'cat' template, 8 directions, 92x92). Base south rotation is sitting, E/W are a low standing stance, and the base north/north-east/north-west rotations are broken (north is a front view), so north walk, sits and stands come from 'Standing'/'Sitting' states.

Standing.edit_description: standing up on all four legs in a relaxed neutral stance, ready to walk, tail raised. The north view shows the cat from behind: its back, tail and the backs of its ears, no face.

Sitting.edit_description: sitting upright on its haunches, front legs straight, tail curled around the front paws. The north view shows the sitting cat from behind: its back, tail and the backs of its ears, no face.

cells.note: real (skeleton-v3 on Standing; the template north walk on Standing was a thin stretched figure, on the base it failed)

real: template 'idle' south (sitting idle loop), every other frame
real: v3 custom lie-down-to-sleep from the sitting pose; ends as a low loaf with eyes closed (not a tight curl)

mittens.unused_animations: Standing 'walk' north (thin stretched figure), Standing 'sitting' north (front view, off-style) and west (never sits), base 'sitting' south (same as idle)
mittens.known_issues: Base north/north-east/north-west rotations are broken (north is a front view); everything north comes from the Standing/Sitting states. The Sitting state cat is a little bulkier than the walking cat. North walk (skeleton-v3) is a mostly black silhouette from behind with white paws and tail tip. Sleep ends as a low loaf with eyes closed (not a tight curl); frame 2 is an awkward face-down transition.

ella.name: Ella
ella.description: Ella, long-haired miniature dachshund, black and tan (PixelLab quadruped 'dog' template, 8 directions, 92x92). The dog template has no sit animation, so row 6 is the standing idle.

cells.note: real: idle south loop, every other frame
real: pre-existing lie-flat-on-belly (east, frames 1-8 of 9); ends lying flat

ella.known_issues: No sit animation exists for the dog template, so row 6 is a standing idle. The pre-existing Run east (rows 4-5) is drawn ~20% larger than the template walk; the west walk is drawn slightly smaller than the east walk. Row 7 is the pre-existing lie-flat-on-belly (east only; no west version in the sheet).

pets_layout.row_5: run west, 8 frames (mirror of run east for all three pets)
pets_layout.row_6: cols 0-3 sit/idle S/E/N/W (one frame each); cols 4-7 idle loop south (every other frame of the 8-frame loop: 0,2,4,6)
pets_layout.row_7: sleep / lie down, up to 8 frames (a one-shot lie-down: play once and hold the last frame)
pets_layout.frame_index: row*8+col (walk S 0-7, E 8-15, N 16-23, W 24-31, run E 32-39, run W 40-47, sit S/E/N/W 48-51, idle S 52-55, sleep 56-63, stand S/E/N/W 64-67)
pets_layout.alignment: each cell entry (strip) gets one vertical offset so its lowest opaque row = the character's feet row (feet_from rotation's lowest opaque row); canvas centred horizontally; never rescaled
